input identity and bounded summaries; validated task returns with atomic
acceptance; a current deterministic verification floor with explicit
local reuse; stage checkpoints; canonical gate reports with class and
recurrence tally; exact-round authorization for gate rounds past 3; and
the hardened report grammar from opponent rounds 9-19.

gap for AC-009 to be repaired on this branch before merge; reality-check
round 2 is NEEDS WORK; hosted CI has not run on this source (AC-019).
